description: A long tunnel like cave that has provided abundant Roman artefacts primarily metalwork from the 2nd - early 3rd CE. The cave has been at times identified as a 'shrine' with an emphasis on deposition of metalwork within a pool inside the cave, but this doesn't seem likely, even to the RSRB.
